added: Networked arenas now keep immediate local shot feedback by playing muzzle flashes and shoot audio as the local player fires.
fixed: The local client no longer spawns gameplay projectiles in shared arenas, preventing duplicate shots when the server owns projectile creation.

added: The client now initializes audio through a scene-backed autoload, with separate menu music volume control.
fixed: Leaderboards update deterministically from authenticated players, de-duplicate repeated entries, and render kill counts consistently.
The local HP bar now follows health changes directly, and leaving the arena from the T key is handled centrally.

added: Server-side projectile diagnostics now skip extra tracking work when debug logging is off.
fixed: Auth handshakes only mark as sent after the packet is accepted, preserving retries on transient send failures.
Projectile fire-origin tolerance now uses the configured tick interval, keeping compensation aligned with server timing.

added: Client prediction now waits for an authoritative sync before becoming active.
fixed: Reduced desync by replaying inputs on the server tick cadence and ignoring small compressed-position jitter.
Improved reconciliation for state updates and correction acknowledgements so early movement drift settles deterministically.
